asset.name: Toolbar
asset.description: The composite action row with roving focus, logical groups, separators, overflow menu, responsive collapse, and shortcut hints.

requires.reason: Sizing, spacing, and radius resolve to declared ramps rather than literals.
Composite widgets expose a single tab stop with arrow-key movement.
Group boundaries are expressed with separators rather than containers.

suggests.reason: Overflow needs a menu only where the toolbar can exceed its container.
Shortcut hints require a registry; a toolbar without keyboard bindings does not.
